text:
zoe: quick design sync 1: API Credentials empty state + revoke/rotate UI. New mock: https://img.redwood.mock/creds-empty-v5.png. Goals: avoid accidental revokes, clarify rotate, make a11y solid. quick takes?

rahul: don't surface revoke on empty state. Primary CTA = "Create credential"; secondary = "Import existing". Revoke belongs in key-row or detail.

marie: for high-risk creds require typed confirmation in modal (user types full key name). For lower-risk, simple confirm with checkbox. Rule: typed confirm if last-used <24h OR attached services >1.

ben: rotate modal: show small checklist: services affected (with last-used), overlap TTL selector (10m/1h/24h), and visible risk indicator. Tooltip: "Rotate: new key created, old key remains during overlap TTL."

sam: accessibility: modal must set focus to heading, trap focus, aria-modal=true and aria-describedby points to the impact list. Escape returns focus to opener. Ensure keyboard-visible focus ring on destructive CTA.

zoe: microcopy proposals: modal title: "Revoke credential". body: "Revoking will immediately invalidate this key. Affected services: X, Y. If you need zero downtime, choose Rotate instead." Buttons: [Cancel] [Type name to confirm: revoke] (destructive red).

access-bot: contrast check: current yellow warning text fails AA at 14px. Recommend darker text (#2b2b2b) or swap to orange background with white text. Mobile: stack CTAs full-width; confirm modals as full-screen sheet.

rahul: role gating: disable revoke button for non-Owners with tooltip "Owner role required to revoke credentials" and link to docs.

ben: undo UX: toast with 9s undo button and aria-live polite. If undone, emit "Key restored" toast and log audit event. If not undone, emit audit log entry with revoke actor + TTL.

marie: spacing nits: illustration needs 24px vertical padding at 360px width. Also ensure table rows have 12px hit target and focus rings.

zoe: actions: marie update mocks with typed-confirm flows + mobile sheets; rahul update copy and role gating tooltip; ben add rotate checklist & undo spec; sam produce accessibility checklist (focus trap, aria-live, keyboard nav). We'll reconvene after mocks. :thumbsup:
